newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3922/3.3953 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3922/3.3953 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3910 to 3.3930 pounds bid and 3.3940 and 3.3980 pounds offered in the interbank market on Wednesday.
A survey of five actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3922 bid and 3.3953 offered compared to 3.3922 pounds bid and 3.3946 pounds offered on Tuesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.390479 buy and 3.397718 sell.
